prompt: What did the pencil-line test establish?
promptZh: 鉛筆線測試證明了什麼？

options.text: The printer's restart had fixed the cut problem.
options.zh: 重啟印表機已排除裁切問題。
options.whyZh: 重啟後結果相同；感測器仍沒讀到原裁切記號。

options.text: All printed cut marks were too faint to read.
options.zh: 所有印出的裁切記號都太淡，無法讀取。
options.whyZh: 報告指出感測器只能讀朝外面，從未確認記號太淡。

options.text: The sensor responded to a visible mark on the exposed side.
options.zh: 感測器對露出那一面的可見記號有反應。
options.whyZh: 它讀到鉛筆線；這足以證明有反應，不能證明它讀得到原記號。

options.text: The labels on all rolls were wound in the right direction.
options.zh: 所有標籤紙捲的捲向都正確。
options.whyZh: 已知有兩卷朝內，測試不是檢查所有紙捲的捲向。

explanationZh: 它讀到鉛筆線；這足以證明有反應，不能證明它讀得到原記號。
evidence: The sensor found the pencil line but not the printed cut marks. This established that the sensor was responding; it did not establish that it could see the original marks.

vocabulary.note: exposed 在此指未被遮住、感測器可讀到的一面。

difficultyRationale: 分辨測試直接支持與無法支持的結論。
